notes.title: Season 11 Competitive Overhaul: New Season, New Rewards.
notes.content:
You spoke, we listened. This update is packed with features you’ve been asking for, designed to make every match more meaningful and every victory even sweeter. It’s time to climb the ranks and look good doing it.

[h2]Put Your Skills to the Test[/h2]
We're rolling out a suite of competitive features to redefine the climb. A completely new Mastery system offers deeper progression, while randomized daily Challenges bring fresh objectives and exclusive loot. And for the ultimate bragging rights? Share your stats and decklists with your own public profile URL and claim your spot on the new seasonal Leaderboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178110/4a79787fea3d47770fad5b2e5249d0aabc3e12ca.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]All-New Season Mastery:[/b] Explore three deep branches, each with four specialized milestones. Conquer them all to unlock a final, ultimate node.
[*] [b]New types of rewards:[/b] Load up on skill points, credits, bits to compile cards, exclusive avatars, and new VS screen banners & frames.
[*] [b]Public Profile URLs:[/b] Your personal hub to display your global and seasonal stats. Show off your winning decks, or keep your secrets safe—the choice is yours.
[*] [b]Dynamic Challenge System:[/b] Face new randomized quests every day with scaling rewards for easy, medium, and hard difficulties.
[*] [b]Challenge-Only Loot:[/b] Earn a new, specially designed card every week and collect monthly sleeves you can’t get anywhere else.
[*] [b]Season Leaderboard:[/b] Cement your legacy. The top 50 players will now be immortalized at the end of each season.
[/list]



[h2]Define Your Style[/h2]
Victory is one thing, but winning with style is everything. Drop into a brand-new battleground inspired by the dark, oppressive atmosphere of Curators Maxima and activate your skills with a flash of personality, thanks to 9 slick new hacking device animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178110/d8a327f53d244a2933e6161f3b1c50f0c388b771.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]New Battleground:[/b] Embrace the gloom and doom of the Curators Maxima.
[*] [b]New Hacking Animations:[/b] Trigger one of 9 new device animations whenever you activate a skill.
[/list]


[h2]Full Changelog[/h2]

[list]
[*] New Battleground added.
[*] New Season Mastery and Leaderboard.
[*] New onboarding experience with a revamped tutorial and new rewards.
[*] New Challenges system with randomized quests and difficulty-based rewards.
[*] New weekly card rewards and monthly sleeves exclusive to the Challenges system.
[*] New Mastery rewards: VS screen background banners & frames.
[*] 9 new hacking device animations when activating a skill.
[*] Public Profile URLs with an option to show/hide decks.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements & Bugfixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed: transforming a card would incorrectly remove any additional traits form its internal cache so that it would not trigger correctly.
[*] Changed: disabled all kinds of stat reset when a card gets moved into a different zone
[*] Fixed: simplified and fixed the logic of InsaneMax that could lead to a wrong calculated attack boost.
[*] Fixed Demotivation not working in some cases
[*] Improved UX and info of challenges
[*] Fixed: reworked Hackenstack to have a simpler and more robust logic for applying it mana cost decreasing permanent effect.
[*] Changed: removed the skip combat opponent PnP phase and made it so that if the turn player passes without any glitches on board then the opponent will always get their main phase instead of it being skipped.
[*] Fixed: Necronomics could be activated with less than 2 glitches in GY
[*] Added: a new animation when a card fails to resolve for some reason (aka. fizzles)
[/list]

notes.title: Your Game, Just Better.
notes.content:
[p]We've been hard at work making The Lost Glitches a better experience for everyone, and this update is all about a smoother, more stable, and more rewarding game. We’ve been digging through your feedback and are excited to roll out these changes.

[/p][h2]So, what's new?[/h2][p]
We're introducing a bunch of quality-of-life improvements that you’ve been asking for. Our goal is to make the game feel more intuitive and let you focus on what matters most: the battles.

[/p][h2]The Nitty-Gritty Details[/h2][p]
Here’s a full rundown of what this update brings:


 [b]Smarter Matchmaking:[/b] Ever had an opponent time out and leave you hanging? We've added a watchdog to our matchmaking system to handle these situations gracefully.
 [b]Softer Seasonal Rank Reset:[/b] We heard you loud and clear. The seasonal rank reset is now more forgiving, dropping you only one rank, not all the way to the bottom.
 [b]Smoother Turns:[/b] We’ve tweaked the timing for turns and actions, so the stack resolution feels more natural and responsive.
 [b]Auto-Claim for Data Cores:[/b] No more extra clicks. Your Data Cores will now be automatically claimed after you complete a match.
 [b]Consistent Glitch Health:[/b] Glitch health will no longer drop below zero, making it consistent with how the Overflow talent works.
 [b]Bug Squashing:[/b] We’ve fixed some edge cases with the "Sacrificial Lamb" card and made a host of other stability improvements.

We're always listening, so keep the feedback coming![/p]

notes.title: The "Command+Z" Update is here!
notes.content:
Sometimes you just need an undo button. And sometimes, you just want the game to go faster. This update is all about giving you more control and more speed, based directly on your feedback.

[h2]Undo This.[/h2]
Ever played a software card and immediately wished you could take it back? Now you can. You can cancel any software while it's targeting. For ultimate control, head to the settings and disable autoconfirm to get a cancel option on every card you play. Your misclicks are officially a thing of the past.

[h2]Don't Waste A Second.[/h2]
We're speeding things up. The stack will now automatically resolve if your opponent has no response, getting you to the action faster. We love speed, but we also love options, so you can turn this off in the settings if you prefer the manual approach.

[h2]Hoot Went To College.[/h2]
Our training AI, Hoot, has been hitting the books. He's now significantly smarter and can handle more complex strategies, providing a much better challenge for when you're testing out new decks and ideas.

[h2]The Great Rebalance.[/h2]
We’ve been listening closely to your discussions about the meta. This update brings a massive wave of balancing changes to skills and cards to ensure gameplay stays fair, diverse, and free of abuse.

[h2]No Glitch Left Behind.[/h2]
There’s nothing worse than finding the perfect match, only for a connection drop on the VS screen to send you back to an endless queue. We’ve fixed that. The matchmaker will now auto-reconnect, getting you into the game without the frustrating wait.

[h2]Full Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added the option to cancel glitches/software during targeting.
[*]Added an autoresolve option for faster gameplay.
[*]Added support for Traditional Chinese.
[*]Added a separate "Deals" section in the store.
[*]Added auto-restarting search in matchmaking when an opponent disconnects during the VS screen.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a case where the opponent's avatar wouldn't load in the battleground.
[*]Significantly improved the loading time of battlegrounds.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[b]Cards:[/b]
[list]
[*]Chaos Oracle: 1/4 -> 3/4
[*]Circle of Life: "Destroy all allies. You heal 2 for each sacrificed Glitch." -> "Destroy all allies. You heal 3 for each sacrificed Glitch."

[*]Reckless Renegade: 1/4 -> 2/5; Cost 3 -> 2; "Whenever this attacks, deal 3 damage to the defending Glitch or Player and 4 damage to this at the end of combat." -> "Whenever this attacks, deal 2 damage to it. (before the attack)"
[/list]

[b]Skills:[/b]

notes.title: Balancing patch (changelog 0.9.9.91)
notes.content:
Our first big balancing patch after the steam release focuses mainly on buffing cards that had less success or popularity than we'd like to and nerfing some skills that are performing a little too well.

[b]Cards:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bodyshield: "Sacrifice an ally in order to play this. Stop Software with a cost of 3 or lower." -> "Sacrifice an ally in order to play this. Stop Software with Installation required."
[*] Chaos Oracle: 2/2 -> 1/4
[*] Defensive Assault: +2 power -> +3 power
[*] Elixir of Aggression: Cost: 1 -> 2, Plug & Play -> Installation required, "Remove {Protector} from all allies until end of turn." -> "Remove {Protector} from all allies."
[*] Encrypt: Cost 2 -> 1
[*] Erazer: Cost: 3 -> 2, Plug & Play -> Installation Required
[*] Fleetfoot Gambit: Cost: 3 -> 2
[*] Magus' Apprentice: 2/2 -> 1/4
[*] The Pirate Queen: 1/4 -> 2/4, Cost: 3 -> 4, added Troll
[*] Pointless Purge: Cost 1 -> 0
[*] Robot Thing: Cost: 3 -> 1
[/list]

[b]Skills:[/b]
[list]
[*] Pacify: Cost 4 -> 6

We also adjusted the usage of the word "ally" to be more clear. Now "Ally" includes the card itself, if it doesn't we use "another ally". These are the affected cards. This is a text only change, all their effects stay the same:
[list]
[*] Capy Engineer 
[*] Colour Augmentor 
[*] Data Sucker 
[*] Friend Bot 
[*] Socialite
[*] Speedy Scrapper
[/list]



[b]We also did some bugfixes & improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Oracle Trick to last until end of turn
[*] Fixed Grave Replicant not working as intended when transformed
[*] Fixed cost reduction calculations
[*] Fixed case where Software would count as played even if fizzled

[*] added fixed dates for challenges: Dailies reset every day at 17:00 UTC+2, Weeklies every Monday at 17:00 UTC+2, Monthlies on the 17th of every month at 17:00 UTC+2
[/list]

notes.title: The Lost Glitches Roadmap & FAQ
notes.content:
[h1]Hello from our Team![/h1]
Hey everyone! We wanted to take a moment to express our deepest gratitude for your continued support and enthusiasm for our game. We're a small but passionate team, and every message, discussion topic, and review you send our way is incredibly valuable to us. We read each and every one, and we're constantly working to tackle issues and implement improvements as quickly as we can. Your input helps shape the future of our game, and we couldn't do it without you!
We prepared answers to the most frequently asked questions and our very first roadmap laying out our plans for the future. Your feedback can change which features we prioritize so definitely let us know what you’re most excited about.

[h1]Frequently Asked Questions[/h1]

[h2]How does ranked/unranked work?[/h2]
Ranked mode pits you against other players, and your performance directly impacts your season score and ranking. Unranked mode is intended for friendly matches, and is only available when playing via password with a friend.

[h2]How do seasons work?[/h2]
Seasons are monthly, giving you fresh opportunities to climb the ranks! At the end of each season, you will receive rewards based on your final rank. We’re working to add an overview of the season rewards in the season page.
Here’s more information on our ranking system: https://playlostglitches.com/rankings/

[h2]What about crypto?[/h2]
Although collectors can indeed get tradable packs on our website, the only benefit they have is that they can trade those cards (a feature not yet fully released).
There's no play to earn mechanics or any gameplay advantage when having those cards, it's purely cosmetic. There's also no crypto in-game.

We felt trading is a "natural" fit to a TCG and we're very adamant against any abusive mechanics and patterns. Gameplay and user experience are and will remain our top priority.	

[h2]What is the difference between classic & collectors packs?[/h2]
Classic and collectors packs give the same amount of cards, have the same drop rates and contain the same cards. 
Classic packs have a 3% chance to give cards with a dark background, otherwise they drop the classic cards you all love.
Collectors packs give cards that have a sleek holo effect for you to show off in battle.

[h2]What is the drop rate of cards?[/h2]
Both classic and collectors packs have the same drop rate. 
Common: 54%
Uncommon: 31%
Rare: 10%
Epic: 3.8%
Legendary: 1.2%

[h2]Where can I find the rarity of my cards?[/h2]
The rarity of each card is an icon above its description. Here’s what those icons mean.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178110/abe14088688e6f412cbdbb00d57d6c5ccd5b1cfb.png[/img]


[h1]Roadmap[/h1]
Our game is currently in active development, and we have a lot of exciting features planned for both the short term and long term. Here’s a glimpse into what’s coming:

[h2]Ongoing[/h2]
[*] [b]Bug fixes and performance improvements.[/b] The game automatically sends us reports when there’s an exception or error. You can also report tickets (bugs or suggestions) from within the game. These send us logs and screenshots of the current state and help us improve the game.
[*] [b]Balance adjustments based on community feedback.[/b] The game automatically saves gameplay data of cards and skills so we can track which cards and skills are OP or not played often. We balance those cards out based on these data (and your feedback). We are very careful of the balancing changes we make to not change the core essence of the card/skill.

[h2]Short-Term Goals[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Releasing more cards.[/b] Based on the meta, we plan to release around 50 cards that will help balance the game further. These cards won’t introduce any new mechanics, but will solidify some strategies and balance the game further. A new set of 100 cards is also in the works, which will introduce new game mechanics!
[*] [b]Steam Login.[/b] We hear you. The game currently requires custom authentication to support cross platform gameplay (use your account across multiple platforms; currently the epic store). We will soon deploy a steam-login feature, which won’t require you to create an account and can continue playing with your steam account.
[*] [b]Support for more languages.[/b] The game currently supports english, german and french. We plan to add more languages, starting with Portuguese and Russian. More languages will be added based on your requests and user-base.
[*] [b]Add interactions on the battlegrounds.[/b] Many of you sent the feedback that the battlegrounds are gorgeous to watch and enjoy the animations, but you’d like to trigger them yourselves. While waiting for the opponent to play, we will deploy micro-interactions on the battlegrounds. These will be fun and playful things you can do on the battleground to pass the time. 
[*] [b]Battle log.[/b] We get it, sometimes you’re not looking at the battle and then suddenly the full board is empty. We’re working on a history of all actions and combat during battle so you can track what happened in previous turns.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178110/7f668fc25393789f10f8ba38faffdf8301bc5067.gif[/img]

[h2]Mid-Term Goals[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Adding new cosmetic items.[/b] Personalizing the game is core of the experience. You can already do that by switching sleeves and avatars, but we have more cosmetics in the pipeline:
[u]Finishers[/u]. When you win the final strike that finishes the opponent will be customizable. Imagine arcane power, toxic acid or just kill them with rainbow love.
[u]Emotes[/u]. Express yourself with different emotes that reflect your personality.
[u]Charms[/u]. Yes, we all love the shroomie on the battlefield. Still you’ll be able to get other characters that will be your support animal during the most challenging steps of the battle.
[u]Action Avatars[/u]. Your avatar can be more than just a representation, it can become an extension. When triggering a skill, an animated avatar will unleash that skill and bring their personal touch to combat.
[*] [b]Trading[/b]. If you decide to get tradable packs, you will be able to trade the cards from those tradable packs with other players to our custom marketplace.
[*] [b]Compile/decompile cards.[/b] A deck doesn’t allow more than three copies of a card, so collecting more than three copies is currently useless. But soon, we will deploy compiling/decompiling cards. You will be able to “burn” cards and will be able to “compile” a specific card you’re missing from your collection. The “decompile” rate will be defined by the rarity of the cards.
[/list]


[h2]Long-Term Goals[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]PvE mode[/b]. The Lost Glitches has a deep lore and the current version of the game just scratches the surface of it. A single player, narrative campaign will introduce you to the world, the syndicates and its characters. The campaign consists of five chapters and we will be releasing those gradually.
[*] [b]Competitive tournaments[/b]. For some players, playing ranked in TLG isn’t competitive enough! We will run regular tournaments with bigger rewards than the ones given by the season ranking.
[/list]

We will be following the conversation and might reorder priority of the tasks based on your thoughts. Thank you all for tuning in <3
